text: はしゃぎ　すぎて　つかれちゃった

structure.en: I got too excited, and so

patterns.name: 〜すぎる
patterns.explanation: すぎる added to a verb means doing it too much. The て ending here also gives the reason for what follows. はしゃぎ すぎて = 'I romped around too much, so'.

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: ちゃった is the casual short form of てしまった, which says the thing happened completely, often to your regret. つかれちゃった = 'I've gone and worn myself out'.
